notes.title: SMTP too long line
notes.text:
Some antivirus scanners dies when they process an email with a too long string without line breaks.
Such a message was sent. If there is an antivirus on your MTA, it might have crashed. Please check its status right now, as it is not possible to do it remotely.

remediations.details:
Solution type: VendorFix
Contact the vendor of the antivirus scanner to get an update.

vulnerabilities.title: OpenVAS / Greenbone Vulnerability Manager Default Credentials

notes.title: OpenVAS / Greenbone Vulnerability Manager Default Credentials
notes.text: The remote OpenVAS / Greenbone Vulnerability Manager is installed/configured in a way that it has account(s) with default passwords enabled.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Workaround
Change the password of the mentioned account(s).

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Certificate Expired
notes.text: The remote server's SSL/TLS certificate has already expired.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Mitigation
Replace the SSL/TLS certificate by a new one.

vulnerabilities.title: Check if Mailserver answer to VRFY and EXPN requests

notes.title: Check if Mailserver answer to VRFY and EXPN requests
notes.text: The Mailserver on this host answers to VRFY and/or EXPN requests.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Workaround
Disable VRFY and/or EXPN on your Mailserver.
For postfix add 'disable_vrfy_command=yes' in 'main.cf'.
For Sendmail add the option 'O PrivacyOptions=goaway'.
It is suggested that, if you really want to publish this type of information, you use a mechanism that legitimate users actually know about, such as Finger or HTTP.

notes.title: CGI Scanning Consolidation
notes.text:
The script consolidates various information for CGI scanning.
This information is based on the following scripts / settings:
- HTTP-Version Detection (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.100034)
- No 404 check (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.10386)
- Web mirroring / webmirror.nasl (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.10662)
- Directory Scanner / DDI_Directory_Scanner.nasl (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.11032)
- The configured 'cgi_path' within the 'Scanner Preferences' of the scan config in use
- The configured 'Enable CGI scanning', 'Enable generic web application scanning' and 'Add historic /scripts and /cgi-bin to directories for CGI scanning' within the 'Global variable settings' of the scan config in use
If you think any of this information is wrong please report it to the referenced community portal.

notes.title: Greenbone Security Assistant (GSA) Detection
notes.text: The script sends a connection request to the server and attempts to determine if it is a GSA from the reply.

notes.title: HTTP Security Headers Detection
notes.text: All known security headers are being checked on the host. On completion a report will hand back whether a specific security header has been implemented (including its value) or is missing on the target.

notes.title: Services
notes.text: This routine attempts to guess which service is running on the remote ports. For instance, it searches for a web server which could listen on another port than 80 or 443 and makes this information available for other check routines.

vulnerabilities.title: SSL/TLS: Collect and Report Certificate Details

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Collect and Report Certificate Details
notes.text:
This script collects and reports the details of all SSL/TLS certificates.
This data will be used by other tests to verify server certificates.

vulnerabilities.title: SSL/TLS: HTTP Public Key Pinning (HPKP) Missing

notes.title: SSL/TLS: HTTP Public Key Pinning (HPKP) Missing
notes.text: The remote web server is not enforcing HPKP.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Workaround
Enable HPKP or add / configure the required directives correctly following the guides linked in the references.

vulnerabilities.title: SSL/TLS: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Missing

notes.title: SSL/TLS: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Missing
notes.text: The remote web server is not enforcing HSTS.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Workaround
Enable HSTS or add / configure the required directives correctly following the guides linked in the references.

vulnerabilities.title: SSL/TLS: Perfect Forward Secrecy Cipher Suites Missing

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Perfect Forward Secrecy Cipher Suites Missing
notes.text: The remote service is missing support for SSL/TLS cipher suites supporting Perfect Forward Secrecy.

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Report Medium Cipher Suites
notes.text: This routine reports all Medium SSL/TLS cipher suites accepted by a service.

vulnerabilities.title: SSL/TLS: Report Non Weak Cipher Suites

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Report Non Weak Cipher Suites
notes.text: This routine reports all Non Weak SSL/TLS cipher suites accepted by a service.

notes.title: SSL/TLS: Report Supported Cipher Suites
notes.text:
This routine reports all SSL/TLS cipher suites accepted by a service.
As the NVT 'SSL/TLS: Check Supported Cipher Suites' (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.900234) might run into a timeout the actual reporting of all accepted cipher suites takes place in this NVT instead. The script preference 'Report timeout' allows you to configure if such an timeout is reported.

notes.title: wapiti (NASL wrapper)
notes.text:
This plugin uses wapiti to find web security issues.
Make sure to have wapiti 2.x as wapiti 1.x is not supported.
See the preferences section for wapiti options.
Note that the scanner is using limited set of wapiti options. Therefore, for more complete web assessment, you should use standalone wapiti tool for deeper/customized checks.
Note: The plugin needs the 'wapiti' binary found within the PATH of the user running the scanner and needs to be executable for this user. The existence of this binary is checked and reported separately within 'Availability of scanner helper tools' (OID: 1.3.6.1.4.1.25623.1.0.810000).

notes.title: Postfix SMTP Server Detection
notes.text: The script checks the SMTP server banner for the presence of Postfix.

notes.title: SMTP antivirus scanner DoS
notes.text: This script sends the 42.zip recursive archive to the mail server. If there is an antivirus filter, it may start eating huge amounts of CPU or memory.

remediations.details:
Solution type: Mitigation
Reconfigure your antivirus / upgrade it.

notes.title: SMTP Missing Support For STARTTLS
notes.text: The remote SMTP server does not support the 'STARTTLS' command.

notes.title: SMTP Server type and version
notes.text: This detects the SMTP Server's type and version by connecting to the server and processing the buffer received.

notes.title: OpenVAS / Greenbone Vulnerability Manager Detection
notes.text: The script sends a connection request to the server and attempts to determine if it is a OpenVAS Manager (openvasmd) or Greebone Vulnerability Manager (gmvd).

notes.title: Service Detection with '<xml/>' Request
notes.text:
This plugin performs service detection.
This plugin is a complement of find_service.nasl. It sends a '<xml/>' request to the remaining unknown services and tries to identify them.

notes.title: CPE Inventory
notes.text: This routine uses information collected by other routines about CPE identities of operating systems, services and applications detected during the scan.

notes.title: OS Detection Consolidation and Reporting
notes.text: This script consolidates the OS information detected by several NVTs and tries to find the best matching OS. Furthermore it reports all previously collected information leading to this best matching OS. It also reports possible additional information which might help to improve the OS detection. If any of this information is wrong or could be improved please consider to report these to the referenced community portal.

notes.title: Traceroute
notes.text: A traceroute from the scanning server to the target system was conducted. This traceroute is provided primarily for informational value only. In the vast majority of cases, it does not represent a vulnerability. However, if the displayed traceroute contains any private addresses that should not have been publicly visible, then you have an issue you need to correct.

remediations.details: Block unwanted packets from escaping your network.
